summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026, furnishing a news release reporting third fiscal quarter 2026 results for the period ended July 31, 2026. The Canadian foreign private issuer, listed on Nasdaq and TSXV, disclosed record revenue of $198.8 million, up 33% year over year, record gross profit of $52.7 million at a 27% margin, record Adjusted EBITDA of $16.2 million at 8.2% margin, record net income of $12.7 million, and operating cash flow before working capital changes of $11.9 million with free cash flow of $7.0 million. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is present; this is a routine earnings current report, so the special-situations category is None. What to watch: no risk-arb angle applies here; the filing is informational only, with no deal or corporate-action terms to trade against.
